info.title: Bureau of Labor Statistics Universal API
info.description: Access public U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics time-series data, popular series, and survey metadata through the BLS Public Data API.

get.description: Retrieves the latest data point for a Bureau of Labor Statistics series.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: seriesId
parameters.description: BLS time series ID. Use uppercase BLS format, for example LAUCN040010000000005.

schema.description: BLS time series ID. Use uppercase BLS format, for example LAUCN040010000000005.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

value.description: Latest value as returned by BLS.

data.description: Latest data point for the series.

status.description: BLS request status returned by runtime.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Finds Bureau of Labor Statistics data for one or more series.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: seriesid
parameters.description: One or more BLS series IDs. BLS expects the JSON key seriesid with an array of IDs.

schema.description: One or more BLS series IDs. BLS expects the JSON key seriesid with an array of IDs.

parameters.name: startyear
parameters.description: Optional four-digit start year for the requested time frame.

schema.description: Optional four-digit start year for the requested time frame.

parameters.name: endyear
parameters.description: Optional four-digit end year for the requested time frame.

schema.description: Optional four-digit end year for the requested time frame.

parameters.name: catalog
parameters.description: Optional BLS flag to include catalog metadata when available. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.

schema.description: Optional BLS flag to include catalog metadata when available. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.

parameters.name: calculations
parameters.description: Optional BLS flag to include available net and percent calculations. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.

schema.description: Optional BLS flag to include available net and percent calculations. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.

parameters.name: annualaverage
parameters.description: Optional BLS flag to include annual averages when available. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.

schema.description: Optional BLS flag to include annual averages when available. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.

parameters.name: aspects
parameters.description: Optional BLS flag to retrieve aspects associated with data points when available. BLS registration may be required for enhanced optional fields.
